advisor.buffer_pool_small.title: The buffer pool is small for your data
advisor.buffer_pool_small.text: InnoDB data and indexes take {data}, but only {pool} fit in memory, so many reads go to disk.
advisor.buffer_pool_small.fix: Raise innodb_buffer_pool_size (50–70% of the RAM on a dedicated database server).
advisor.tmp_disk.title: Many temporary tables go to disk
advisor.tmp_disk.text: {pct} of the temporary tables (GROUP BY, ORDER BY, UNION…) didn’t fit in memory ({tmpSize}).
advisor.tmp_disk.fix: Look at the heavy queries with “tmp disk”; raise tmp_table_size and max_heap_table_size together if they need it. TEXT/BLOB columns always go to disk.
advisor.connections_near_max.title: Connections came close to the limit
advisor.connections_near_max.text: Up to {used} connections were open at once, out of {max} allowed. Above the limit new clients get “Too many connections”.
advisor.connections_near_max.fix: Check for connection leaks or a pool that is too big; raise max_connections if the server has memory for it.
advisor.aborted_connects.title: Many failed connection attempts
advisor.aborted_connects.text: {aborted} connection attempts failed ({pct}): wrong passwords, missing privileges or network timeouts.
advisor.aborted_connects.fix: Check the server error log and the applications’ credentials; repeated failures from one host can mean a brute-force attempt.
advisor.no_primary_key.title: Tables without a primary key
advisor.no_primary_key.text: {count} tables have no primary key: InnoDB adds a hidden one, replication gets slow and rows can’t be edited safely.
advisor.no_primary_key.fix: Add an id INT UNSIGNED AUTO_INCREMENT PRIMARY KEY column, or a primary key on the columns that identify a row.
advisor.myisam.title: MyISAM tables
advisor.myisam.text: {count} tables use MyISAM: no transactions, table-level locks and they can break after a crash.
advisor.myisam.fix: Convert them with ALTER TABLE … ENGINE=InnoDB (off-peak: it rebuilds the table).
advisor.fk_without_index.title: “…_id” columns without an index
advisor.fk_without_index.text: {count} columns that look like relations have no index, so every JOIN or filter on them reads the whole table.
advisor.fk_without_index.fix: Add an index on the ones you join or filter by: CREATE INDEX idx_col ON table (col).
advisor.duplicate_indexes.title: Duplicate indexes
advisor.duplicate_indexes.text: {count} groups of indexes cover the same columns in the same order: they slow down every write and use space for nothing.
advisor.duplicate_indexes.fix: Keep one of each group and drop the rest with DROP INDEX.
advisor.slow_log_off.title: The slow query log is off
advisor.slow_log_off.text: Without it, slow queries leave no trace when performance_schema is off.
advisor.slow_log_off.fix: SET GLOBAL slow_query_log = ON; and long_query_time = 1 (also in my.cnf so it survives a restart).
advisor.query_cache_on.title: The query cache is on
advisor.query_cache_on.text: With {size} of query cache every write invalidates entries under a global lock, which hurts with several CPUs.
advisor.query_cache_on.fix: Set query_cache_type = 0 and query_cache_size = 0 (MySQL 8 removed it).
advisor.all_good.title: Nothing to worry about
advisor.all_good.text: None of the checks found a problem.

maint.hint.CHECK: CHECK: looks for errors in the table and its indexes.
maint.hint.REPAIR: REPAIR: fixes a damaged MyISAM / Aria table. Not for InnoDB.
maint.hint.CHECKSUM: CHECKSUM: a number that changes when the data changes (compare two copies).
